sources.excerpt: Kathryn Merteuil is a fictional character from the Cruel Intentions franchise, created for it by Roger Kumble based on the Marquise Isabelle de Merteuil from Pierre Choderlos de Laclos's 1782 novel Les Liaisons dangereuses.
